subject: Business Models
title: Indirect Network Effects
description: A short lesson to help you apply Indirect Network Effects.

hook.text: More iPhone users attract more app developers. More apps attract more iPhone users. A virtuous cycle.

buildup.text: Indirect network effects happen across sides: one side's growth benefits the other side.

discovery.text: Windows dominated PCs because it had the most software. Developers built for Windows because it had the most users.

twist.text: Indirect effects can reverse too. As developers left BlackBerry, users followed. The spiral went negative.

climax.text: Indirect network effects explain why platform battles are winner-take-most. The loop reinforces itself.

punchline.text: Users attract developers, developers attract users. The loop decides.

quiz.question: What are indirect network effects?
options: Growth on one side benefits the other side
